purpose: Compare a small fixed candidate set by nested grouped cross-validation on previously opened V8 records without selecting or evaluating an official V9 model.
preprocessing: StandardScaler inside each training partition for elastic-net only; tree candidates use raw authenticated features.
sample_weighting: Each connected component has total weight 1 inside each fit or metric partition.
calibration: Platt logistic regression with C=1000000 fitted on grouped inner out-of-fold logits inside each outer-training partition.
threshold_selection: Choose the component-weighted balanced-accuracy maximum on calibrated inner OOF predictions; ties prefer closest to 0.5 and then the lower threshold.
warning: Exploratory analysis on previously opened V8 records. Not an official V9 model selection or final evaluation.
